c74object.name: mc.ear.play~
c74object.digest: Play an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the audio is streamed from disk and comes out on three multichannel outlets with the file's tracks routed for mc.ear.objects~, mc.ear.direct~ and mc.ear.hoa~, and the metadata comes out of three message outlets for the same renderers, timed by the audio itself (each Objects block is emitted with the EAR's interpolation rules as 'setvalue N ramp' followed by its parameters). 'open' reads the file and reports its rendering items on the info outlet; 'start' (or 1) plays from the beginning, 'stop' (or 0), 'pause', 'resume' and 'seek' control the transport
c74object.description: Play an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the audio is streamed from disk and comes out on three multichannel outlets with the file's tracks routed for mc.ear.objects~, mc.ear.direct~ and mc.ear.hoa~, and the metadata comes out of three message outlets for the same renderers, timed by the audio itself (each Objects block is emitted with the EAR's interpolation rules as 'setvalue N ramp' followed by its parameters). 'open' reads the file and reports its rendering items on the info outlet; 'start' (or 1) plays from the beginning, 'stop' (or 0), 'pause', 'resume' and 'seek' control the transport. The output channel counts follow the file when the audio is restarted. Files larger than 4 GB (RF64/BW64) play, and a file at another sample rate is converted to the audio's as it streams.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Report the file, its programmes, rendering items and warnings on the info outlet
method.description: Report the file, its programmes, rendering items and warnings on the info outlet.

method.name: float
method.digest: 1 plays from the beginning, 0 stops (as mc.sfplay~)
method.description: 1 plays from the beginning, 0 stops (as mc.sfplay~).

method.name: loop
method.description: Set the loop attribute. Loop the file: the playback continues from the start when it reaches the end, and the metadata starts over with it.

method.name: open
method.description: Open an ADM (BW64) file: 'open path'. Reports the file, its programmes and rendering items on the info outlet, sends the static bed and scene metadata to the renderer outlets and emits the object metadata for time 0. The signal outlets take the file's channel counts when the audio is restarted.

method.name: overview
method.digest: Write a waveform overview of the open file into a buffer~ for waveform~: 'overview name [bins per second]' (100 by default)
method.description: Write a waveform overview of the open file into a buffer~ for waveform~: 'overview name [bins per second]' (100 by default). The file is scanned on a thread of its own, then the buffer~ gets one channel per file track and two samples per bin, the lowest then the highest sample of the bin, at a sample rate of twice the bins per second, so waveform~ draws the file's own timeline. 'overview name channels bins bins-per-second' is reported on the info outlet when the buffer~ is written.

method.name: pause
method.digest: Stop playing at the current position; 'resume' continues from there
method.description: Stop playing at the current position; 'resume' continues from there.

method.name: position
method.digest: Report the playback position in milliseconds on the info outlet
method.description: Report the playback position in milliseconds on the info outlet.

method.name: programme
method.digest: Select the audioProgramme to render by index (1-based) when the file has several, and route the file again
method.description: Select the audioProgramme to render by index (1-based) when the file has several, and route the file again.

method.name: resume
method.digest: Continue playing from the current position
method.description: Continue playing from the current position.

method.name: seek
method.digest: Move to a position in milliseconds ('seek 0' rewinds) and emit the metadata there; playing continues if it was
method.description: Move to a position in milliseconds ('seek 0' rewinds) and emit the metadata there; playing continues if it was.

method.name: start
method.digest: Play from the beginning (the metadata starts over too)
method.description: Play from the beginning (the metadata starts over too).

method.name: stop
method.digest: Stop playing; 'start' plays from the beginning again
method.description: Stop playing; 'start' plays from the beginning again.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.digest: Loop the file: the playback continues from the start when it reaches the end, and the metadata starts over with it
attribute.description: Loop the file: the playback continues from the start when it reaches the end, and the metadata starts over with it. Default: 0.
